text: 中金公司公告称，公司拟开展换股吸收合并重大资产重组项目的A股异议股东收购请求权有关事宜，已获证监会批复同意吸收合并东兴证券和信达证券。为确保A股异议股东收购请求权实施顺利进行，公司A股股票将自2026年9月15日开市起连续停牌。
text_en: CICC announced that it plans to proceed with matters related to the acquisition request rights of A-share dissenting shareholders in its major asset restructuring project involving share-exchange absorption and merger, having received CSRC approval for the absorption and merger of Dongxing Securities and Cinda Securities. To ensure smooth implementation of the acquisition request rights for A-share dissenting shareholders, the company's A-shares will be suspended continuously from market open on September 15, 2026.
